title: Weekly targets and better Arabic messages
changes: Your week: salespeople now see their sales against a weekly target (Saturday to Friday), with a mark for where the week is today.
Team: the owner and managers see each person’s week on their card, and can set the targets under “Weekly targets”.
Arabic WhatsApp messages are rewritten to read naturally, and are signed with your Arabic name.
The owner now chooses who a WhatsApp message is from, so it is never sent unsigned.
A message with no product named now says “the watch”, and Arabic messages name the shop in Arabic.

title: Customers: focus on the ones that matter
changes: Customers now opens on Top: customers who spent 1,000 KD or more, or bought 3+ times, and were seen in the last year.
New filters: Win back (top customers not seen for a year) and New (first purchase in the last 60 days). Each shows how many.
Searching still looks through every customer.
Each customer shows a Top, Win back or New tag. The VIP filter is replaced by Top.

title: Customers and occasions fixed
changes: Customers: tapping “3 customer occasions” now shows those customers.
Customer search now looks through every customer, not just the first 1,000.

title: Hours no longer counted twice
changes: If a clock-in goes through twice, your hours today are no longer added up twice; a second clock-in while you are already clocked in is now refused.

title: Customers, visits and the end of the day
changes: Log a customer visit as Browsing, Interested, Lost Opportunity or Manual Sale.
Set the visit time when you log it late, and correct it afterwards.
Typing a phone number tells you whether the customer is new, yours, or already known.
A lost opportunity can be saved when the customer would not give a number.
Salespeople open on their own Home: the shop, the clock, what is waiting and today's visits.
New tabs: Home, Today, Follow-ups, Customers and Me. Managers find Team under More.
Customers: each customer's visits, Lightspeed purchases, notes and dates on one page.
Send WhatsApp from a customer, a follow-up or a birthday, with English or Arabic templates.
Birthday and anniversary reminders arrive a week before and on the day.
Today's log shows what Lightspeed rang up for the shop.
Colleagues' customer phone numbers are hidden.
Each salesperson logs in as themselves and sees their own follow-ups.
My Portal, requests and the notification bell are inside this app.
Close Day closes only the shop you chose, and offers the summary for WhatsApp.
The day report PDF is sized for a phone.
Clocking out works even when the phone cannot find your location.
Fixed: the app going white on iPhone Safari.
Fixed: the visit outcome buttons now show which one is chosen.
The version now shows under the title. Tap it to see this list.
